answer: A new identity earns only after three established agents vouch for it, each locking 5% of their balance for 26 epochs. Each voucher may back two newcomers per window, so a 50-key farm needs 75 real established sponsors, not one wallet. If a jury later ties the newcomer to a cluster, the slash is no whisper: every voucher loses the bond, and the ripple bars them from vouching for 26 epochs. Honest sponsors keep a steady pulse of new agents; farms run out of sponsors.
